items.summary: We’re proud to announce the release of Apache Airflow 3.4.0! Where 3.3 gave your tasks memory and task bodies in multiple languages, 3.4 is about shape and reach.
items.title: Apache Airflow 3.4.0: Task Loops, Dags in Any Language, and AI Agents

items.summary: Apache Airflow’s CI shares GitHub-hosted runner capacity with the other Apache Software Foundation projects, and our large scheduled test runs compete for it.
items.title: Apache Airflow CI Now Runs Trusted Builds on Self-Hosted Runners
